title: Zephyr: SCHC link layer integration
description: Integrate SCHC with link layer in Zephyr C. Acceptance: compressed/fragmented packets flow through link layer, respects memory constraints.
notes: 2026-08-27 Zephyr integration audit: existing lichen_link_tx() compresses into fixed 256-byte scratch, wraps one 0x14 dispatch, and emits exactly one signed frame; packets beyond the authenticated frame body fail -EMSGSIZE. lichen_link_rx() authenticates then directly decompresses one 0x14 body; fragmentation Rule 0x78/0x79 is not dispatched to schc_reassembler. lichen_l2_tx()/rx likewise submit/consume one frame and have no ACK-on-Error session lifecycle. Generic schc_fragmenter/reassembler codecs exist, and lichen_link_rx_payload() exposes authenticated raw bytes, but Zephyr peer_table contains only EUI-64/pubkey/last_seen/active: no opaque key generation, authenticated DIO policy binding, session admission floor, or tombstone owner. Directly wiring generic codecs would violate spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6 requirements for full-key canonical direction, current generation revalidation, authenticated 24-bit counters, and control issuance. Created blocking child project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.3.7.6 with explicit bounded authority acceptance; it depends on existing cross-implementation direction/generation defects 4wty and 13kv. This integration also depends on 7dyd, whose pinned canonical format-v2 runtime remains blocked by gz30. No source edits made; Link/L2 ownership was checked and clear.
